## Jeffy Support Router — self-hosted n8n

Classifies an incoming support message into one of 77 banking intents, then routes it by **how confident** the classifier is rather than by label alone.

**Setup**
1. Settings → Community Nodes → install `n8n-nodes-jeffy`
2. Create a **Jeffy API** credential. Base URL `https://playground.jeffyclassify.com` works with no signup, or point it at your own `jeffy-serve`
3. Select that credential in the Jeffy node, then hit Execute Workflow

No API key, no LLM, no per-call cost. Runs on CPU.

On n8n Cloud, community nodes cannot be installed yet — use `cloud-http-router.json` instead, which does the same thing with an HTTP Request node.

### Replace this

Swap the Code node for your real trigger (Webhook, Gmail, Chatwoot, Zendesk, Front) and map the ticket text onto `message`.

### Why route on confidence

`confidence` is the top class probability, `margin` is the gap to the runner-up. A high confidence with a thin margin means two intents look alike, so it is a close call, not a safe auto-route.

Tune `AUTO`, `SUGGEST` and `MIN_MARGIN` against your own labelled tickets. These defaults are a starting point, not a recommendation.
